\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item The title \duallayerbox{Dalai Lama}{Bodhisattva} means which of the following?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Ocean of Love
    \item Lover of Wisdom
    \item Ocean of Wisdom
    \item Stillness of Love
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following movements was founded by Mordechai Kaplan?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Liberal Judaism
    \item Reform Judaism
    \item Conservative Judaism
    \item Reconstructionist Judaism
\end{enumerate}
\item In Islam, what is the qiblah?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Almsgiving
    \item Pilgrimage
    \item Direction of prayer
    \item Revelation
\end{enumerate}
\item What is the Decalogue?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item The Exodus
    \item The Covenant
    \item The Ten Commandments
    \item The creation story
\end{enumerate}
\item In Jainism, what is the cycle that one must liberate oneself from?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Punya
    \item Samsara
    \item Samayika
    \item Jiva
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
